shortDescription: Goodyear Middle East FZE serves as the regional commercial and administrative headquarters for Goodyear tires across the Middle East and Africa.
whatTheyDo: The regional entity oversees commercial strategy, sales operations, marketing, and distribution coordination for Goodyear passenger and commercial tires across the Middle East and Africa. In the UAE, it operates from Dubai Silicon Oasis and coordinates with local automotive distributor networks.

shortDescription: Gucci is an Italian luxury fashion house operating retail boutiques and a regional corporate office in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Gucci designs and retails high-end leather goods, ready-to-wear fashion, footwear, fragrances, and accessories. In the UAE, it manages flagship retail boutiques in premier retail centres including The Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates, alongside a corporate management office under registered entity Luxury Goods Gulf LLC.

shortDescription: The Gulf Petrochemicals and Chemicals Association (GPCA) is a regional industry trade body representing downstream chemical and petrochemical producers in the Arabian Gulf.
whatTheyDo: GPCA represents the interests of the chemical and petrochemical industries across the GCC through advocacy, technical conferences, research studies, and networking platforms. It runs regional sustainability standards such as Gulf SQAS and educational initiatives for STEM university students.

whatTheyDo: GWR Consulting specializes in customer experience measurement, mystery shopping auditing, service quality assessment, and compliance evaluations. It serves retail, banking, automotive, and hospitality clients across the UAE, measuring brand standards and frontline employee compliance.

shortDescription: Habib Bank AG Zurich (HBZ) is an international commercial bank with extensive retail, trade finance, and corporate banking operations in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Habib Bank AG Zurich provides commercial banking, trade financing, business accounts, treasury services, and personal retail banking. Operating in the UAE since 1974, it maintains a branch network across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other emirates, with its UAE zonal management located in Umm Al Sheif.
address: Building 367-1013, Umm Al Sheif, Sheikh Zayed Road, P.O. Box 3306, Dubai, UAE
notes: Two distinct banking institutions share the 'Habib Bank' name in the UAE: Habib Bank AG Zurich (HBZ, Swiss-incorporated, in UAE since 1974, zonal office in Umm Al Sheif) and Habib Bank Limited (HBL, Pakistan-incorporated, in UAE since 1967, main branch in Bur Dubai). Neither bank maintains a branch or office in JLT.
